main_text.p: [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters] [illegible, ~18 letters]

Requiescere fac in regno tuo caelesti nos, & illos post egressum nostrum de hoc mundo; & ignosce, transfer, & remitte peccata nostra, ac Defunctorum fidelium, voluntaria, & inuoluntaria, vel deliquerimus scienter, vel ignoranter. Hinc quidem cognoscimus, peccata, & delicta dimitti non solum in hoc mundo, verum etiam in alio; Deumque exigere peccata in hoc, & illo mundo, vel commissa sint scienter, vel ignoranter. Et sane nisi ea exigeret, nequaquam pro illis Ecclesia deprecaretur; & nisi dimitteret, nequaquam Commemorationem faceret Defunctorum omni tempore, neque supplicaret pro illis in omnibus orationibus. Deum autem exigere peccata, & delicta quedam in eo mundo, manifestum est ex Euangelio: Non exies inde, donec reddas nouissimum quadrantem. Beatus vero Paulus Epistola prima ad Corinth.

page.notes: The six Syriac lines at the top could not be read letter by letter, so each is marked illegible; the letter counts are estimates. The printed sentence "Requiescere fac..." is a fragment continuing from the previous page, and the page ends mid-sentence at "Corinth." with the catchword "indi-" below.
